spans.text: In this stage, allied support squads respective grant allied echelons increased vision per turn and EMP Grenades per turn.
Consecutive kills made by allied squads each turn grant a stacking 200-point score bonus. (Initial 200, max 1000)
Please note - when an allied non-heavy squad moves more than 8 positions in a turn, expended AP is increased by 1. (Long press an echelon to view movement made this turn)
Capture nodes in this stage to gain additional score. Destroying rubble piles awards 50,000 score. Best of luck, Commander.
